basic_info.description: Meticulously renovated Victorian in vibrant Hayes Valley, where timeless San Francisco architecture effortlessly blends with elevated modern living. With reimagined designer interiors and a thoughtfully updated floor plan tailored for today's lifestyle, this home exudes both charm and sophistication. Featuring soaring ceilings, gorgeous white oak floors, and sunlit spaces that flow seamlessly from the open kitchen and living area to a private garden  an inviting retreat perfect for morning coffee & gatherings. The kitchen is outfitted with beautiful custom cabinetry and high-end appliances, including a Bertazzoni Master Series range. Upstairs are 3 beds on one level, including a top-floor primary suite and laundry. A spacious en-suite room on lower level provides flexibility media room, play room, or home office. With updated systems throughout including plumbing, electrical, windows, roof, heating and AC, this home is as turnkey as it is timeless. Located in the heart of Cerebral Valley's thriving AI and tech hub and just blocks Hayes Valley's thriving AI and tech hub and just blocks celebrated boutiques and cafes, this home offers unparalleled access to the very best of San Francisco living.
